commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the free kick from long distance. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
90+2' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) brings an opponent down and Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Berenguer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Unai Nunez (Ath Bilbao).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The linesman signals that Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
89' 0 - 2 Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) collects the ball deep inside the box from a rebound following the corner kick. He beats the keeper with a sharp low shot in the middle! Quite a nice goal!
89' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is about to take a corner kick.

88' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Ath Bilbao have a corner.
87' A cross from a corner kick by Ath Bilbao is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
87' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) coming on for Andoni Gorosabel.
85' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Mikel Jauregizar and he is replaced by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao).
85' Ramon Terrats goes off the pitch and Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe) comes on.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Allan Nyom (Getafe) for Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez.
85' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) replacing Christantus Uche.
84' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
83' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Guillermo Cuadra who sees an offensive foul.
79' Substitution. Peter Federico (Getafe) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Coba da Costa walks off.
76' 0 - 1 What a screamer! The ball falls to Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box after several rebounds and he doesn't hesitate to rifle it off the post into the bottom right corner.
75' The Ath Bilbao players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
73' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
70' A yellow card for a tackle by Luis Milla (Getafe). Guillermo Cuadra doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

70' Coba da Costa (Getafe) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Unai Simon makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.

69' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
67' Alvaro Rodriguez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
67' Unai Simon steps in and intercepts a long pass from Omar Alderete (Getafe).
66' A pass by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is behind the touchline and Getafe will take a throw-in.

65' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
63' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
62' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball in, but David Soria comfortably gathers the ball.

61' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. David Soria makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
61' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes it short.
61' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.

60' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
60' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
59' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
57' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) replaces Maroan Sannadi.
57' We are about to witness a substitution. Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Unai Gomez.

57' Diego Rico (Getafe) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
55' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
54' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for holding. Guillermo Cuadra signals a set piece.
53' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
48' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
48' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
47' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Ath Bilbao.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Guillermo Cuadra has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Guillermo Cuadra had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

43' What a great effort! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
42' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Ramon Terrats (Getafe) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
42' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:0.
41' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
40' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends the corner into the box, but Unai Simon intercepts it and averts the threat.

40' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.
39' Luis Milla (Getafe) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
39' Christantus Uche (Getafe) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

37' A rebound sits up perfectly for Mauro Arambarri (Getafe), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

36' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
36' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
35' Ath Bilbao are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
32' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao).

30' Unai Simon doesn't have to worry about that one. Diego Rico puts a cross in towards Mauro Arambarri (Getafe), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
29' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
28' A long pass, executed by Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for Getafe.
26' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a throw-in.

25' Christantus Uche (Getafe) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
23' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
23' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes.
22' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 36:64.
19' Christantus Uche (Getafe) commits a foul and Guillermo Cuadra immediately signals a free kick.
17' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner but it's cleared.
17' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
16' Referee Guillermo Cuadra makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Ath Bilbao. Let’s see what happens!
15' Surely that's handball by one of the Getafe players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
15' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Ath Bilbao win a corner.
14' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Ramon Terrats (Getafe) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The ball has crossed the sideline. Ath Bilbao are taking a throw-in.
13' A long pass, executed by Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
11' He should have scored! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
10' A pass by Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. It's a throw-in for Getafe.
9' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' Christantus Uche (Getafe) sends an accurate pass to Coba da Costa, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
5' Neat passing move from Ath Bilbao in order to create new attacking opportunities.
3' A lofted pass picks out Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
2' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Ath Bilbao will kick the game off.
Guillermo Cuadra is the one to supervise the game today.
